# Formatting your submission file

To format your submission file, you can use the following code:

```{r submission-1, code=readLines("R/submission/write_submission.R"), fold="Submission function", message=FALSE}
source("R/submission/write_submission.R", local = TRUE, print.eval = TRUE)
```

```{r submission-2}
## Make predictions
set.seed(2023)
predictions <- predict(final_model, features_test, type = "raw")

## Write to file
submission_file <- file.path(output_dir, "submission.csv")
submission <- write_submission(predictions, rownames(x_test), submission_file)

## Check result
cat(readLines(submission_file, n = 20), sep = "\n")
```
